{
  "problem_id": "TA-008",
  "lane_id": "openai-raw",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "OpenAI frontier reasoning models at high reasoning effort, general-purpose long-context models for literature processing, code-execution sandboxes, symbolic and numerical optimization tools, and Lean 4 or an equivalent proof assistant",
  "execution_posture": "non_governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 25000000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 8000000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 40000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 6500,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 6000,
  "estimated_retries": 1800,
  "estimated_search_cost": 35000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 0,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 220000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 300000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 1150000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 6000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 4000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 12000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 35000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.16,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.48,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.03,
  "confidence": 0.22,
  "assumptions": [
    "These are prospective planning estimates and do not claim observed autonomous feasibility.",
    "The target includes the sharp all-dimensional bound, treatment of equality or extremal cases, and a proof acceptable to specialists in convex and discrete geometry.",
    "The reproduction probability assumes access to the known theorem-specific literature and measures successful proof reconstruction, gap checking, replication, and publishable formal exposition or formalization.",
    "The independent-result probability assumes theorem-specific proofs are withheld during discovery while standard background literature remains available; because this lane is non-governed, independence would have limited audit credibility.",
    "Token estimates are central totals across researchers, critics, branch managers, literature agents, computational agents, proof reconstructors, formalizers, and independent verifier agents.",
    "Reasoning tokens are counted separately from visible output tokens and are assumed to be billed or compute-equivalent to high-effort model generation.",
    "Central cost includes model inference, retrieval infrastructure, storage, sandbox compute, numerical and symbolic experiments, proof-assistant workloads, orchestration, repeated critic passes, replication, and manuscript production.",
    "Elapsed hours are wall-clock hours under substantial parallelism, not the sum of agent-hours.",
    "Search cost covers acquisition and parsing of relevant papers and books, citation-graph exploration, semantic indexing, and retrieval calls; it excludes inference already represented in the token totals.",
    "Verification cost covers isolated proof review, adversarial counterexample searches, independent computational replication, dependency auditing, proof-assistant checking where tractable, and final specialist-style manuscript review.",
    "No cost is assigned to identity hashing, budget enforcement, branch receipts, evidence-preservation controls, or policy-check infrastructure because the requested lane is non-governed."
  ],
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "Whether the decisive published argument relies on a short conceptual insight or a long chain of highly specialized geometric reductions",
    "The amount of tacit expertise required in convex geometry, geometry of numbers, lattice-point methods, and extremal classification",
    "Current models' ability to generate genuinely new global inequalities rather than recombine nearby literature",
    "Difficulty detecting subtle gaps involving normalization, dimension dependence, degeneracy, compactness, or equality cases",
    "Availability and formalizability of supporting results in proof-assistant libraries",
    "Compute required for low-dimensional searches, candidate-extremizer discovery, and falsification of intermediate conjectures",
    "Context contamination from theorem-specific literature when assessing independent rediscovery",
    "API pricing, model capability changes, rate limits, and the degree of effective parallelism",
    "Editorial standards for calling a reconstruction, alternative proof, or formalization publishable"
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A precise theorem identifying the maximum volume in every dimension under the stated centroid and interior-lattice-point conditions",
    "A complete proof with every external lemma traced to a verified source or reproved",
    "Explicit handling of affine normalization, lattice invariance, full dimensionality, limiting cases, and equality or extremal configurations",
    "Adversarial review by multiple independent model instances using isolated contexts",
    "Low-dimensional computational checks and targeted searches for counterexamples to all major intermediate claims",
    "Independent reconstruction of the main proof from a dependency graph rather than the drafting context",
    "Machine-checked formalization of the central inequality and delicate reductions where feasible, with remaining informal steps clearly enumerated",
    "A clean replication package containing literature records, code, experiment seeds, proof dependencies, counterexample searches, and manuscript sources",
    "For an independence claim, timestamped sealed discovery artifacts and a documented theorem-specific literature exclusion protocol, although the non-governed posture cannot strongly attest compliance"
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "A key step may require a genuinely new geometric idea outside the reliable discovery range of current autonomous systems.",
    "The all-dimensional argument may resist inference from computationally accessible low dimensions.",
    "Small errors in centroid conditions, lattice normalization, polarity, or equality analysis can invalidate an otherwise plausible proof.",
    "Relevant background theorems may be difficult to retrieve, have incompatible hypotheses, or lack machine-readable proofs.",
    "Full formalization may require substantial new libraries for convex bodies, volume, centroids, and lattice geometry.",
    "The non-governed lane provides no reliable identity hashing, budget enforcement, branch receipts, policy audit, or tamper-evident evidence preservation.",
    "Access to the known proof can make reproduction substantially easier while making credible independent-rediscovery claims substantially harder."
  ]
}
